option_relations.rationale: Organizing pneumonia secondary to COVID-19 is a specific lung pathology that can occur after COVID-19, but it is not directly related to Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
Persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection in an immunocompromised patient (long COVID) describes a prolonged course of COVID-19, which is distinct from Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) pneumonia refers to the acute infection, which is not Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
COVID-19 pneumonia (SARS-CoV-2 infection) refers to the acute infection, which is not Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
